info.name: BrainAge Connect | Complete API lifecycle
info.description:
# BrainAge Connect

COM661 CW1 - Boyu Yuan, B01089181.

Research MRI metadata and user-supplied precomputed result management using Flask and MongoDB. The API does not perform MRI inference or issue clinical diagnoses. All age values are postmenstrual weeks.

## Quick start
Start the synthetic demo at http://127.0.0.1:5001, import LocalDemo.postman_environment.json and run all requests in their existing order. Requests share tokens and resource IDs through collection variables. The runner creates a temporary researcher and sample, exercises the lifecycle and disables the temporary account. Use python -m scripts.run_postman for an isolated database that is deleted afterwards.

## Authentication and access
Use Authorization: Bearer {{token}} for authenticated requests and {{admin_token}} for administrator operations. Demo-only credentials are included in the environment. Registration creates an inactive researcher; administrator approval is required. Sample writes require owner/admin; nested writes require author/admin. Private inaccessible records return 404.

## Requests and responses
Send JSON with Content-Type: application/json. Unknown fields and invalid types/ranges are rejected. Lists contain data and pagination; details contain data. Errors contain error.status and error.message. IDs are 24-hex ObjectId strings and dates are UTC ISO 8601. PUT/PATCH update supplied fields only. 201 means created; 204 has no response body.

## Examples and evidence
Saved examples originate from actual isolated Newman executions of this collection. Authentication tokens are redacted. They are software test fixtures, not real research records. Example IDs belong to a disposable database and should be replaced with variables when making a live request.

## Statistics
Visibility filtering precedes aggregation. Maturity uses the newest CREATED result per sample/modality; comparison requires both dMRI and fMRI results. Sources are grouped separately. Maturity accepts method/model_version filters and optional age-group summaries. Comparison accepts separate dMRI/fMRI method and model_version filters. Filters apply before latest selection; unfiltered means can mix models and remain descriptive. Cohort bins count scan sessions, not independent infants.

## Documentation provenance
This is a Postman Collection v2.1 artifact with descriptions, request payloads, test scripts and saved examples. Its accompanying local PDF is rendered from the collection and is not a printout exported by the Postman desktop application.
